name: polviewx
label: Liberal or conservative-Version X

questions.text:
C. In political matters, people talk of "the left" and "the right."  How would you place your views on this scale?  
(SHOW CARD S. Do NOT PROMPT. IF RESPONDENT HESITATES, ASK R TO TRY AGAIN. MARK ANSWER BELOW.)

name: libtemp
label: Feeling thermometer:liberals

questions.text:
I'd like to get your feelings toward groups that are in the news these days. I will use something we call the feeling thermometer, and here is how it works: I'll read the names of a group and I'd like you to rate that group using the feeling thermometer. Ratings between 50 degrees and 100 degrees mean that you feel favorable and warm toward the group. Ratings between 0 degrees and 50 degrees mean that you don't feel favorable toward the group and that you don't care too much for that group. If we come to a group whose name you Don't recognize, you don't need to rate that group. Just tell me and we'll move on to the next one. IF you do recognize the name, but you don't feel particularly warm or cold toward the group, you would rate  at the 50 degree mark. Our first group is liberals. How would you rate this group using the thermometer? 
A. Liberals

name: ethorgs
label: Do ethnic orgs promote separatism

questions.text:
Now I'm going to read you some statements and would like to get your reaction to them. After I read each statement, please tell me if you strongly agree, agree, neither agree nor disagree, disagree, or strongly disagree with the statement.
Political organizations based on race or ethnicity promote separatism and make it hard for all of us to live together.

name: engballt
label: Attitude toward printing ballots only in English

questions.text: Do you believe that election ballots should be printed only in English, or in areas where lots of people don't speak English, should they also be printed in some other languages?

name: owneth
label: Do ethic politicians serve ethnic groups better

questions.text: Do you feel that people are best represented in politics by leaders from their own racial or ethnic background, or doesn't the leader's background make very much difference?

name: congeth
label: Should ethnic congressmen represent ethnic groups

questions.text:
Some people say that it is only fair that in a society like ours, people holding public office should have roughly the same racial or ethnic background as the population as a whole. So, for example, if 30pct of the people were Hispanic, then 30pct of the public officials should be Hispanic as well. Others say that in choosing people for public office they should be considered purely on the basis of ability without regard to their ethnic or racial background. Let me ask you about these ideas in several different areas. 
A. What about people in Congress?  Should they have the same racial or ethnic background as their constituents, or should they be considered purely on the basis of their ability without regard to their racial or ethnic background?

Let me ask you about these ideas in several different areas.
questions.item: A. What about people in Congress?  Should they have the same racial or ethnic background as their constituents, or should they be considered purely on the basis of their ability without regard to their racial or ethnic background?
